findings.assumptions: No additional mathematical assumptions are accepted. The hive identification, seed Ehrhart calculation, ambient unimodular lift, zero-part embedding and Horn-product assertion remain unverified. Reported rank-four integrality and exploratory census results receive no independent proof credit here.
findings.dependencies: The supplied studies and journal support the existence of a concrete candidate and document the search limitations. The move-note proofs, computational certificates, cited full texts, and shared search and reading records are not delivered. These omissions prevent acceptance of the asserted footholds but do not invalidate their explicitly provisional use as research candidates. Polynomial Horn factorization alone supplies no polytope-level product decomposition.

The exact statement and N1/N2 were covered by q1 hive/scissors/equidecomposability/period-collapse (0 results), q2 Littlewood–Richardson/period-collapse/equidecomposability (1), q8 rational-polytope/Ehrhart/lattice-polytope/period (1), q3 scissors-congruence/Ehrhart (2), q4 period-collapse/Ehrhart (13), and q7 Ehrhart-equivalence (10). N3 used q6 Gelfand–Tsetlin with equidecomposability, period collapse or Ehrhart terms (7). N4 and N5 used q5 stretched Littlewood–Richardson or hive-polytope terms (10). Each was reported complete for its query, not exhaustive of the literature. Supplemental searches on the same date included reported complete arXiv and zbMATH responses, bibliographic Crossref top-10 results, and Semantic Scholar searches with several HTTP 429 gaps. Underlying search records and complete reading records are referenced but absent from the delivered evidence.
openness.reason: The narrative novelty study cannot establish supported openness without its bound search results, dispositions and complete readings. Potentially relevant sources remain abstract-only, including Thawinrak, Clarke–Higashitani–Zaffalon, Ardila–Bliem–Salazar and Erbe–Haase–Santos; their relevance has not been resolved by delivered records. The unavailable King–Tollu–Toumazet sources receive no reading credit, and their dates or reported topics do not establish irrelevance. No fully read settling source is delivered. This reassessment expressly excludes an openness claim and is not root closure, so unresolved openness does not prevent its limited approval.

findings.policy: The reviewed-proof requirement remains binding: subsequent results require delivered proofs, including hive inequalities, boundary-compatible simplex refinement, disjointness, convexity, integrality and ambient unimodularity where applicable. Exploratory computations cannot substitute for certificates. Continuation remains subject to the aggregate limits of 24 moves, 24 runs and one worker; this approval neither resets resources nor accepts any mathematical obligation.
findings.scope: Approval concerns only the proposed retirement of this recorded search and continuation with explicitly testable construction hypotheses. All four listed obligations remain open. Neither universal coverage, smallest unresolved-case minimality, novelty, nor root closure is established.
findings.statement: Approved as a bounded scientific reassessment, not as a proof of the root proposition or the seed instance. Stopping the recorded negative search does not exhaust negative approaches. The explicit cut-and-shear candidate supports further investigation without establishing its conclusion. The subject correctly withdraws the claims that N1 is as hard as the target and that negative monomial coefficients obstruct lattice-polytope realizability.
